# Review - PR 573 @ ecc7cbb75810341d8053478595aaf9e3b3e9a10b

Independent review by a Claude Opus helper (owner-authorized 2026-09-17); no author, fixer or prior reviewer context reused. Trusted prompt, persona and policy ref: 0aee21ce5e4c30cba9ff50478694cbd9c52074f9. Four files, +204/-59 against base main (merge-base 24906961bf355542ead568f991a5738cda96fe07): two new Lean theorems that preserve the `lem:qld-4-12` assembly and the uniform Naimark ancilla, plus the matching blueprint node, status flip and paper-gap update.

## Findings

- [ ] F1 (prose; changes) docs/paper-gaps/qpbt-gap-register.md:26 - the status cell of the `qpbt_linearity-theorem-quotation.tex` row asserts "no common-extension theorem exists yet" and describes the note as recording "the common-extension obligation"; both are false at this head, since `exists_exactly_linear_observables_commonAncilla` supplies exactly the uniform ancillary space, and the note itself now says so. The PR removed the sentence that designated the register as the complete audit status and replaced it with an admission that the row is stale (docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_linearity-theorem-quotation.tex:363-365) rather than correcting the row. Fix: update that status cell to the uniform-ancilla result with the residual zero-state-padding assumption, and add `lem:linearity-common-ancilla` to the row's blueprint-node column.
- [ ] F2 (prose; changes) docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_linearity-theorem-quotation.tex:45-46 - the rewritten "Combined points" item reads "This replaces the binary-linearity argument; it does / does not establish the source's padding assumption": the replacement line kept the preceding line's trailing "it does", so the sentence is ungrammatical and, read literally, inverts the intended claim. Fix: delete one of the two "does" (keep "it does not establish the source's padding assumption").
- [x] F3 (code; minor, non-blocking) MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points.lean:18 - locator drift inside one file: the module docstring (line 18) and the `CombinedPointsWitness.extendedQ` docstring (line 40) still cite `...tex:993-1011`, while `extendedQ_spec` (line 229) and `exists_extendedQ` (line 318) now cite `:993-1018` for the same lemma. In the mirror the statement ends at line 1011 and the proof at 1018, so both spans are defensible individually; four locators for one lemma in one file are not. Fix: use one span consistently (statement `993-1011`, or `993-1018` where the coarse-graining proof is also formalized).

## Review

Checked, against the trusted `github/main` copies of `local/personas/reviewer.md`, `local/personas/prose-reviewer.md`, `local/protocols/review.md`, `docs/CONTRIBUTING.md` section 5 and the proof-integrity / Faithful Formalization sections of `AGENTS.md`:

Code. `exists_extendedQ` (Points.lean:318) is a genuine assembly, not an obligation: it obtains the witness from `exists_combinedPointsWitness` and applies `extendedQ_spec`, so the joint measurement is constructed rather than hypothesised, and no hypothesis was added. Its four conclusions match the source lemma and the blueprint node line for line - projectivity of `points.extendedQ side x z alpha beta`, self-consistency, and both ordered products `M^X_a M^Z_b` and `M^Z_b M^X_a` summed over `alpha*a + beta*b = c` - with the paper's "all symmetric equivalents" captured by the `forall p1 p2, p1.IsOpposite p2` quantifier and a single `deltaQ` carrying `IsPolyErr`, which is the `delta_Q` of `lem:qld-4-10` as the blueprint requires (`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:993-1011`, "Furthermore, all symmetric equivalents of these approximations also hold"). `exists_exactly_linear_observables_commonAncilla` (Linearity.lean:188) is the honest strengthening it claims to be: `iota'`, the `Fintype`/`DecidableEq` instances and the unit vector are bound before the quantifiers over `iota`, `delta`, `rho` and the family, the hypothesis is character-for-character the correlation hypothesis of the existing `exists_exactly_linear_observables`, and the conclusion is the same `2 * delta` averaged squared state-dependent operator distance - no weakening, no extra bridge or witness input. The unused `_ht : 0 < t` follows the documented convention of `exists_exact_boolean_representation` (Stability.lean:259, whose docstring says positivity of `t` is part of the quoted statement and unneeded by the proof), so it is not a finding. Reuse checked: `naimarkAncilla`, `norm_naimarkAncilla`, `roundedObservable*`, `avg_stateDepDistSq_roundedObservable_eq_avg_multiplicativeDefect` and `avg_multiplicativeDefect_le_two_mul_error` all come from main; the five-line proof body overlaps `exists_exact_boolean_representation` only because the existential reordering cannot be derived from it. No `sorry`, `admit`, `axiom` or `native_decide` in either file. Both touched files elaborate clean in the PR worktree (which is at the published head): `lake env lean MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Linearity.lean` and `.../Points.lean`, rc=0, no diagnostics. Exact-head CI is green on all nine contexts including `local-ci/build`, `proof-debt`, `proof-evasion`, `statement-origin` and `local-ci/summary`. Commit subject and PR body conform to the conventions.

Prose. The `\notready` to `\leanok` flip on `lem:qld-4-12` is warranted: the linked declaration is proved sorry-free, and its dependency node `lem:qld-4-10` already carries statement and proof `\leanok`. Putting the two implementation declarations on the proof block is an established pattern in this blueprint (30 such proofs on main, one already in ch15). The new `lem:linearity-common-ancilla` is labelled a formalization-only auxiliary, is mathematically equivalent to the Lean statement (quantifier order, `delta >= 0`, density-operator conditions, `2*delta` bound, ancilla index set `F_2^t` disjoint-union a point versus `Option (Fin t -> ZMod 2)`), and every label in its `\uses` exists and is justified - `lem:boolean-representation-stability` is the node that carries `avg_stateDepDistSq_roundedObservable_eq_avg_multiplicativeDefect`, so that edge is not spurious. The `rem:linearity-import` rewrite is a correctness improvement: the old text claimed the two conversions were discharged in the proof of `lem:qld-4-10`, which the field-valued replacement proof does not do. The gap note's characterisation of the source is accurate against `...14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:832` ("By assuming that $\ket{\hat{\psi}}$ has sufficiently many ancilla zero qubits, we do not need to extend the state further"), including the `F_2^{2t}` index length for the fiberwise application. Findings F1 and F2 are the two defects.

Not checked: no full `lake build` and no `#print axioms` run by me - I relied on the exact-head green `local-ci/build` and the rooted audit reported as PASS 1612 / FAIL 0; the correctness of the untouched `exists_combinedPointsWitness` proof and of `extendedQ_spec`'s body beyond their statements; blueprint rendering. There were no earlier marked reviews of this PR, so no prior findings to re-check.

VERDICT: CHANGES_REQUESTED (code=APPROVED, prose=CHANGES_REQUESTED)
